Yesterday, my family went to the zoo together for a special holiday afternoon. We hoped to discover something different and interesting before it was over. The butterfly garden was my favorite place, and everyone wanted to see it. We watched a gorilla eat a banana, and my little brother said it was a wonderful adventure. My mom said it was important to remember days like this because tomorrow we might be busy again. My dad said next weekend we would probably volunteer at a hospital to help people. Ayer, mi familia fue junta al zoológico para una tarde especial de día festivo. Esperábamos descubrir algo diferente e interesante antes de que terminara. El jardín de mariposas era mi lugar favorito y todos querían verlo. Miramos a un gorila comer una banana y mi hermanito dijo que era una aventura maravillosa.
